data.name: Edd
data.gender_notes: Edd is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Old English name Eadweard, composed of the elements ead (wealth, fortune) and weard (guardian, protector). The name Edd signifies 'powerful ruler' or 'wealthy guardian'. This name was borne by several Anglo-Saxon kings, including King Eadweard the Elder and King Eadweard the Confessor. The name Edd carries the meaning “Powerful ruler” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Edd usually hope their child will grow to embody powerful ruler and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Edd belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Powerful ruler.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Edd total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_greek.name: Εδδ

in_latin.name: Edd

in_english.name: Edd
in_english.meaning: Edd means strong, powerful, or wealthy guardian
in_english.long_meaning: The name Edd is a shortened form of various names starting with Ed- or Edd-, which are derived from the Hebrew name אד (Ed), meaning strength, power, or wealthy guardian. Although not directly mentioned in the Bible, similar names such as Edom (Genesis 25:30) and Edan (Exodus 18:4) are referenced. Historically, the name Edd has been used in Christian traditions, symbolizing strength and spiritual vigor. The name is associated with positive personality traits like courage, resilience, and leadership.

data.cultural_impact: The name Edd holds historical significance in Anglian and Christian culture as the name of several Anglo-Saxon kings. This name is a reminder of the strong leadership and wealth that characterized the Anglo-Saxon kingdoms. Additionally, the name has been passed down through generations and is still used as a given name today, reflecting the enduring legacy of the Anglo-Saxon culture and history.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Edd holds spiritual significance as it highlights the importance of protection and wealth in the Christian faith. It is a reminder of the idea that God watches over and protects His people, providing for their needs and ensuring their prosperity. Additionally, the name Edd can serve as a reminder of the Christian virtues of strength and leadership, inspiring individuals to use their God-given abilities to serve and protect their communities.
